parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The username of the account that you want to modify.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB-X 1.0 instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the PolarDB-X 1.0 instance is located.
